title: Student Assistant Accounting
description_md:
This position will provide real-world experience and give you the chance to develop hands-on accounting skills while supporting daily finance operations across our Nordic Hub.

You will work closely with our local accounting team and Shared Service Center in Bucharest, gain insight into vendor and customer accounting processes, and take on responsibility from day one.
